business_problem: simplify a complex, acquisition-heavy data estate so structured and unstructured product information could be governed centrally and reused for customer-facing AI experiences.
solution_summary: IMCD uses Snowflake, Cortex Search, and connected enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Syndigo, and Hyland to build a governed commercial and AI data foundation. Structured ordering, finance, logistics, and customer data, plus large volumes of technical and regulatory documents, are unified in Snowflake so teams across regions and acquired businesses can work from the same scalable environment. Cortex Search adds grounded semantic retrieval over the catalog and document corpus, supporting natural-language discovery on IMCD’s website and B2B portal, while Snowflake-backed AI helps optimize tens of thousands of product descriptions for search. The broader platform standardizes governance and integration across core customer and product-information systems, reducing administration and making acquisitions easier to onboard while improving product discovery and customer service.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the shared and governed data foundation for IMCD’s structured and unstructured commercial data.

solution_components.name: Cortex Search
solution_components.role: Enables grounded semantic search across IMCD’s product and document corpus for teams and customers.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Supplies CRM and customer-engagement data that feeds the shared Snowflake foundation.

solution_components.name: Syndigo
solution_components.role: Contributes product-information content used for IMCD’s catalog and search experiences.

solution_components.name: Hyland
solution_components.role: Supplies document content that is searched and enriched through the Snowflake-based AI stack.

data_flow: Commercial, product, and document datasets from systems such as Salesforce, Syndigo, and Hyland are centralized in Snowflake. Cortex Search then indexes the grounded corpus for semantic retrieval, and curated search outputs are exposed to IMCD teams and customers through website and B2B portal experiences.
business_outcome: IMCD launched eight new AI use cases in a single year, improved product discovery and customer experience, and reduced administrative burden by standardizing data and governance across its global business.
